intent: Make the CommitGuard CI job inspect the actual pull-request branch commit with its parent history available, so the committed-diff audit can run instead of failing on a shallow checkout.
reviewed_by: ChatGPT assistant review against the user's explicit CommitGuard requirements; repository-owner review remains possible
commit_subject: Record workflow history change intention audit

requirements.text: CI must fetch the PR head commit and sufficient Git history for CommitGuard to inspect the changed words and files.

.github/workflows/build-apk.yml.necessity: The CommitGuard job needs the actual PR head and its parent history; the default shallow merge checkout has no HEAD^ and cannot support a fail-closed diff audit.

word_reviews.rationale: Introduces checkout configuration for the CommitGuard job.
Selects the actual PR head SHA, or push SHA outside pull requests.
Audits the pull request source branch commit rather than the synthetic merge commit.
Provides the event commit SHA for non-pull-request runs.
Fetches complete history so the parent diff can be inspected.
Disables shallow history for this checkout.
